info.title: fallout-migrate
info.description: CLI that migrates an existing NUKE consumer repo to Fallout in one command.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Migrate a NUKE consumer repo to Fallout.
What it does:
- Rewrites Nuke.* PackageReferences and MSBuild properties in .csproj
- Rewrites `using Nuke.*` directives and qualified type references in .cs
- Rewrites `dotnet nuke` -> `dotnet fallout` and legacy NUKE_* env vars
in build.cmd / build.ps1 / build.sh
- Renames .nuke/ to .fallout/
- Prints a summary of files changed and warnings to address manually

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would change without writing

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description:
Repository root. Defaults to walking up from the working directory
to find one (looking for build.cmd / build.ps1 / build.sh, .nuke/,
or build/)
